It is not for publication. ::: A hand that picks fruit in a grove. ## Depends on - [grove](../1-soil/grove.mdx) · layer 1 · soil · 4 references ## Used by - [basket](./basket.mdx) · layer 2 · hands · 4 references ## Entities ### Picker Identified by `picker_id` (`PickerId`). | field | type | |---|---| | `grove_id` | `GroveId` | | `started_at` | `timestamp` | Relations: - `grove_id` references **Grove** of [grove](../1-soil/grove.mdx) (one, by `grove_id`) ## Commands ### RetirePicker **Retire a picker.** | field | type | |---|---| | `picker_id` | `PickerId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `no-such-picker` (refused) | no such Picker | `PickerNotFound`: No picker of this identity exists. | | `retired` | otherwise | moves the **Picker** `Active` → `Retired`; emits `PickerRetired` | | `wrong-state` (refused) | the Picker is in a state that does not allow it | `PickerStateConflict`: The picker is not in a state this command acts from. | ### StartPicker **Start a picker.** | field | type | |---|---| | `picker_id` | `PickerId` | | `grove_id` | `GroveId` | | `at` | `timestamp` | | outcome | when | result | |---|---|---| | `started` | otherwise | creates a **Picker** in `Active`; emits `PickerStarted` | ## Events | event | fields | emitted by | |---|---|---| | `PickerRetired` | `picker_id` PickerId, `at` timestamp | `RetirePicker` | | `PickerStarted` | `picker_id` PickerId, `at` timestamp | `StartPicker` | ## Views | view | rows | fields | |---|---|---| | `Pickers`
